description: Create templateManagementStore with list/filter/create/retire/duplicate actions, plus the TemplateManagement UI components (list view, create dialog, retire dialog, status badges) and a 'My Templates' button in the app header for DESIGNER role. Includes comprehensive tests for both store and components.
steps: Step 1 - Create the templateManagementStore at frontend/src/stores/templateManagementStore.ts following the pattern of projectCreationStore.ts. State: templates (Template[]), filteredTemplates (Template[]), filters (status, search, wallGeometry), isLoading, error, selectedTemplateForAction (for retire/duplicate confirm), showCreateDialog, showRetireDialog. Actions: fetchMyTemplates() - fetch all templates where created_by = current user (SELECT * from template where created_by = auth.uid()), applyFilters(), setStatusFilter(status | null), setSearchFilter(text), setWallGeometryFilter(geometry | null), createTemplate(data) - INSERT into template table with status DRAFT, retireTemplate(id) - UPDATE status to 'ARCHIVED' (using the existing TemplateStatus.ARCHIVED enum value), duplicateAsNewDraft(id) - SELECT template by id, then INSERT new copy with status DRAFT and name suffixed ' (Copy)', editTemplate(id) - load template into projectStore and switch to DESIGNER mode, openCreateDialog(), closeCreateDialog(), openRetireDialog(template), closeRetireDialog(), reset(). Use fromTable() helper for all DB queries. Use useAuthStore.getState().user?.id for the created_by filter.

Step 2 - Create frontend/src/components/TemplateManagement/TemplateStatusBadge.tsx. A small component that renders a colored badge span based on template status: DRAFT=gray (#9e9e9e bg, white text), ACTIVE=green (#e8f5e9 bg, #2e7d32 text), ARCHIVED=orange/red (#fff3e0 bg, #e65100 text). Props: status: TemplateStatus. data-testid='template-status-badge'.

Step 3 - Create frontend/src/components/TemplateManagement/TemplateListItem.tsx. Renders a single template row in the list view. Shows: name, status badge (using TemplateStatusBadge), wall_geometry, base_width_mm x base_height_mm, updated_at formatted. Action buttons per status: DRAFT: 'Edit' (calls editTemplate), 'Delete' (only if template has no zones/dependencies - for now just show button, actual dependency check is future). ACTIVE: 'Create Draft Copy' (calls openRetireDialog... no, calls duplicateAsNewDraft), 'Retire' (calls openRetireDialog), 'View' (calls editTemplate in read-only - for now same as edit). ARCHIVED: 'Create Draft Copy' (calls duplicateAsNewDraft), 'View'. data-testid='template-list-item'.

Step 4 - Create frontend/src/components/TemplateManagement/TemplateFilters.tsx. A filter bar with: text search input (data-testid='template-search-input'), status dropdown/buttons (All / DRAFT / ACTIVE / ARCHIVED) (data-testid='template-status-filter'), wall geometry filter (All / STRAIGHT / L_CORNER) (data-testid='template-geometry-filter'). Calls setStatusFilter, setSearchFilter, setWallGeometryFilter on the store.

Step 5 - Create frontend/src/components/TemplateManagement/CreateTemplateDialog.tsx. A modal/dialog overlay (similar to ProjectCreationWizard overlay pattern) with form fields: name (required), description, wall_geometry (STRAIGHT/L_CORNER select), base_width_mm (number, required), base_height_mm (number, required), adaptation_strategy (SCALE/REFLOW/CLIP select). On submit calls createTemplate(). data-testid='create-template-dialog'. Has Cancel and Create buttons. Create is disabled if required fields empty.

Step 6 - Create frontend/src/components/TemplateManagement/RetireTemplateDialog.tsx. A confirmation modal: 'Are you sure you want to retire [template name]? Existing projects using this template will not be affected.' Confirm button calls retireTemplate(id). Cancel closes dialog. data-testid='retire-template-dialog'.

Step 7 - Create frontend/src/components/TemplateManagement/TemplateManagementPanel.tsx. The main panel component that orchestrates everything: renders TemplateFilters at top, a 'Create New Template' button, then the list of TemplateListItem components. Calls fetchMyTemplates() on mount. Shows loading/error/empty states. Conditionally renders CreateTemplateDialog and RetireTemplateDialog when showCreateDialog/showRetireDialog are true. data-testid='template-management-panel'.
Step 8 - Create frontend/src/components/TemplateManagement/index.ts barrel export file exporting TemplateManagementPanel and other components.
Step 9 - Update frontend/src/stores/index.ts to export useTemplateManagementStore and its types.

Step 10 - Update frontend/src/App.tsx to add a 'My Templates' button in the header that is only visible when role === 'DESIGNER'. Clicking it opens the TemplateManagementPanel as an overlay (similar to how ProjectCreationWizard works). Add state tracking: when templateManagementStore has a flag like isOpen or isPanelOpen, render the overlay. Add a simple isPanelVisible boolean to the store for this purpose, toggled by openPanel()/closePanel().

Step 11 - Create frontend/src/stores/__tests__/templateManagementStore.test.ts following the pattern of projectCreationStore.test.ts. Mock @/lib/supabase. Test: initial state, fetchMyTemplates success/failure, applyFilters with status filter, applyFilters with search filter, createTemplate success/failure, retireTemplate success/failure, duplicateAsNewDraft success, editTemplate calls projectStore.loadTemplate and canvasStore.setMode(DESIGNER), reset returns to initial state, openPanel/closePanel.

Step 12 - Create frontend/src/components/TemplateManagement/__tests__/TemplateManagement.test.tsx following the pattern of ProjectCreationWizard.test.tsx. Mock @/lib/supabase. Test: TemplateManagementPanel renders list of templates, shows loading state, shows error state, shows empty state. TemplateStatusBadge renders correct colors for each status. TemplateFilters: search input updates store, status filter buttons work. CreateTemplateDialog: renders form fields, Create button disabled when name empty, calls createTemplate on submit. RetireTemplateDialog: shows template name, calls retireTemplate on confirm. TemplateListItem: shows correct action buttons per status, calls correct handlers. 'My Templates' button visible only for DESIGNER role.
acceptance_criteria: A new templateManagementStore exists with fetchMyTemplates, createTemplate, retireTemplate, duplicateAsNewDraft, editTemplate, and filter actions
TemplateManagementPanel renders a filterable list of the current Designer's templates with status badges
Templates can be filtered by status (DRAFT/ACTIVE/ARCHIVED), search text, and wall geometry
Create Template dialog allows creating a new DRAFT template with required fields
Retire Template dialog confirms retirement and updates template status to ARCHIVED
Duplicate as New Draft copies an ACTIVE or ARCHIVED template as a new DRAFT
Edit Template loads the template into projectStore and switches to DESIGNER canvas mode
'My Templates' button appears in app header for DESIGNER role only
All new code passes TypeScript strict type checking (tsc --noEmit)
New tests cover store actions and component rendering/interactions
All existing 228 tests continue to pass
findings: All 291 tests pass (25 store + 38 component for template management, plus 228 existing). TypeScript strict check passes. Post-review fixes applied: (1) Renamed Delete to Archive button for DRAFT templates with data-testid template-archive-btn; (2) duplicateAsNewDraft strips trailing ' (Copy)' before re-appending to prevent compounding; (3) CreateTemplateDialog validates dimensions > 0 and <= 50000 with error message; (4) editTemplate wrapped in try/catch, surfaces error in store state; (5) fetchMyTemplates adds .order('updated_at', { ascending: false }) after .eq(). Mock chain updated: .eq() now returns { order: ... } in fetch tests.
